reason: Index of the repository's coding guidelines for the core/host/webview split.
core/ must stay pure; the new diff session belongs in core and the host keeps vscode effects.
Forbidden patterns, the memory-only rule, the diff selection rule and the before-done commands.
Unit, page and benchmark conventions for cache behavior and toolbar state.
Protocol unions and optional result fields for DiffSession and matchModeState.
Host/webview state split and re-scan survival; the cache must not outlive a document version.
Diff panel lifecycle, debounce, generation tokens and last-good-document behavior.
Toolbar event ownership and the aria-pressed/aria-busy DOM contract.
Toolbar pending styling uses tokens and component CSS.
Reuse buildDiffDocument/rowsFor rather than adding a parallel diff builder.
The fix spans core, protocol, host and webview; use the cross-layer checklist.
Measured cost of the current toggle and the no-rename equivalence case.
